name: Git Version Control
author: KiCad Forge
description: Track symbol library changes with Git - init, commit, history graph, diff.

actions.name: Git Commit
actions.description: Stage all changes and commit with a message.

actions.name: Git Status
actions.description: Repository overview: initialised, branch, last commit, working-tree changes.

actions.name: Git Init
actions.description: Initialize a Git repository in the library directory and make a first commit.

actions.name: Git History
actions.description: Show commit history. With format=graph_v1 return structured graph v1 data (refs, commits, paging); without format keep the legacy text log.

actions.name: Git Commit Detail
actions.description: Read one commit: metadata, changed files and diff base (optional parent_index or parent for merges).

actions.name: Git Commit File Patch
actions.description: Read the patch of one file in one commit (optional parent_index or parent for merges).

actions.name: Git Diff
actions.description: Show unstaged changes in the working tree.
